frequency_question: How often do paired executive principals successfully sign an extension or renewal of a major transboundary water treaty prior to expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral treaties governing shared river basins with explicit expiration dates where both state principals have functional administrative control; excludes unilateral declarations or failed negotiations abandoned before expiration.

cases.name: 1994 US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime adjustments
2000 Senegal River Basin Water Charter renewals
2015 Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II operational protocol extension
1959 Nile Waters Agreement supplementary protocols (historical bilateral continuity)
1944 US-Mexico Water Treaty Mexican salinity solutions protocol

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named historical instances of major transboundary water resource renewals/protocols between sovereign neighbors.
known_gaps: Does not fully capture small localized minor basin agreements, focusing on major state-level treaties.
validity_reason: State norms regarding vital transboundary water resource management remain stable over multi-year horizons.
